cfallin opened PR #14682 from cfallin:fix-debug-fuel to bytecodealliance:main:

  • Save/restore fuel around each breakpoint patchable callsite.
  • Test that fuel is also mutable from within the breakpoint handler, so e.g. fuel can be reduced to zero causing an immediate out-of-fuel trap on resume.

Fixes #14594.

Idle thought, if you want to pick up a minor refactor in a follow up: it could be nice to have the fuel methods do the if self.tunables.consume_fuel check inside their bodies, rather than make ever caller do it and make the call sites harder to read.
